dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregularly circular and 'C' shaped light gray rings with diffuse gradient perimeters that transition from light exterior bands to darker interior focal points, most prominent on the mid-dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid, high-intensity light-gray pixel clusters concentrated on the anterior lateral region near the neck and scattered sparsely between larger annuli on the mid-body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; a series of smaller high-intensity blobs form a linear chain along the upper-lateral axis behind the head.
